title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta33

## Model-aware mower artwork in Map snapshots

Map snapshots no longer use the H2 mower artwork for every mower.

- Pass `model`, `vehicle_type` and resolved `model_family` into the backend snapshot renderer.
- Select the same automatic artwork families used by Navimower Map Card:
  - H1 / H2 -> H2 artwork
  - i1 / i2 AWD -> i-series artwork
  - i2 LiDAR -> i2 LiDAR artwork
  - X3 -> X3 artwork
  - X4 -> X4 artwork
- H5 currently keeps the H2 fallback until dedicated H5 artwork is available.
- Reuse the Map Card's bundled optimized model artwork while keeping snapshot rendering completely local/offline.
- Keep live position and heading rotation identical to the existing snapshot pose semantics.
- Add regressions that render the same map with H2, i1 and X3 metadata and verify that different mower artwork is produced.
